title: Fluid Responsive Typography via clamp()
explanation: Calculates font sizing dynamically without requiring multiple media query breakpoints. Sets minimum bound (1.125rem), fluid scaling formula based on viewport width (vw), and strict upper ceiling (2.25rem).
caveat: Always combine viewport units with rem/em units (e.g. 0.95rem + 1.25vw) so users who zoom their browser font sizes maintain accessible text scaling.
